name: Kujou Akane
source: [url=https://vndb.org/c22926]Shiori's[/url] elder sister. After Shiori is put into the KRB Program she desperately searches for her. With nothing to bargain with she's forced to sell her body for information.
translation: [url=https://vndb.org/c22926]诗织[/url]的姐姐。诗织被纳入KRB计划后，她拼命寻找妹妹。手中没有可交易的东西，她被迫出卖身体来换取情报。
